quest.title: Sanguine's Lost Book
quest.description: This is a quest based on Mad Cow's submission for our 2014 quest contest!

node.journal_entry: Ever the enterprising adventurer, the Agonian caught wind of a reward offered by Sanguine's chapter of the Sons of Riada for a misplaced tome. The book was lost during the Spellmaster's trip to Monkfield less than one moon ago.

node.tag: talk to the magic supplier in Monkfield
node.journal_entry: $[Vendors.t18_monkfield_arcanist_Name] had a hunch as to where the book might be but he needed time to investigate his log books. In the meantime, and as an 'incentive, he requested the Agonian take care of 'a tiny matter' for him.

task.task_instruction: Talk to $[Vendors.t18_monkfield_arcanist_Name] the Magic Supplier in Monkfield

node.journal_entry: He had requested a sword be forged for him to present as a gift at a distant cousin's wedding but the blacksmiths in Firun never delivered. The blade was supposed to have arrived in Monkfield four nights ago.

node.tag: go to Firum and talk to blacksmith
node.journal_entry: Once found, $[Vendors.u14_firun_blacksmith_Name] informed the Agonian that the sword was indeed supposed to be delivered with the weekly caravan. The caravan, however, never made it to Mercian lands and was thus believed to have been ambushed by bandits somewhere near Monkfield.

task.task_instruction: Talk to $[Vendors.u14_firun_blacksmith_Name] the battle supplier in Firun

node.journal_entry: It seemed that the Agonian now had to search for the bandits that stole the goods in order to recover $[Vendors.t18_monkfield_arcanist_Name] wedding blade.

node.instruction: Locate and interrogate the bandit's boss that stole the goods.
node.journal_entry: Though the Agonian had perhaps interrogated a little too hard, the bandit leader, before succumbing to his wounds, did reveal that all the goods had been delivered to an outpost at the center of the Brockmoor swamps.

action.tag: An Add Quest Area to World-Map Action

node.journal_entry: Amongst a pile of crates, the Agonian finally managed to recover a broken jumble of goods, however they'd need to be returned to $[Vendors.u14_firun_blacksmith_Name] first to be sorted through correctly.

task.task_instruction: Find the location of the stolen goods.

node.tag: back to Firum and talk to blacksmith
node.journal_entry: Quite excited at the recovery of stolen goods (especially AFTER the insurance had been claimed) the blacksmith happily handed over a hefty reward as well as $[Vendors.t18_monkfield_arcanist_Name] wayward blade.

task.task_instruction: Talk to $[Vendors.u14_firun_blacksmith_Name] the battle supplier in Firun

action.tag: An Unlock Quest Item Within The Quest Action

node.journal_entry: All things considered, the Agonian would not have been blamed for feeling that the spellmaster's rather brusque, "ah good, there it is," may have come across as a bit underwhelming. Yet that, and a small bag of gold, were all that were offered before the tome was stuffed, rather unceremoniously, back onto a shelf...

task.task_instruction: Return the book to $[Vendors.u18_sanguine_mage_Name] in Sanguine

node.journal_entry: The arcanist gleefully rewarded the Agonian with a jingling pouch for returning the sword to him, he was sure the gift would upstage all the others at the wedding.

task.task_instruction: Return the sword to $[Vendors.t18_monkfield_arcanist_Name] in Monkfield

node.journal_entry: It was (finally!) time for the book to be returned to its rightful owner in Sanguine.

The Monkfield Magic Supplier, to whom the book was lent, said that he could not locate the book within his library. The Spellmaster thus urged the Agonian to proceed to the Mage's Guild in Monkfield and investigate.
The Agonian, blissfully unaware of the road ahead, set off on this seemingly simple task.
$[Vendors.t18_monkfield_arcanist_Name] therefore asked that the Agonian locate $[Vendors.u14_firun_blacksmith_Name] the battle supplier in Firun and learn what had gone awry.

He also had some good news about the missing tome. He'd located it (in his own words) 'quite cunningly' in the cellar. A young night guard interested in joining the Sons of Riada had "borrowed" it intent on studying it and joining the order. Some of the cellars more intoxicating items of storage, however, had evidently been too tempting and the book had been forgotten.

quest_item.description_unlocked: A jumbled assortment of stolen goods, hopefully a blade fit for a wedding gift lies hidden somewhere therein.
A blade fit for a wedding gift!

quest_item.name_unlocked: On the Castings and Rituals of the Arcane: For Dunces.
quest_item.description_unlocked: The once wayward tome belonging to the local chapter of the Sons of Riada in Sanguine. Known to have once spent some time in a cellar...
